details.summary: An excellent, highly practical recipe that completely nails the brief. It perfectly balances Mediterranean flavors with the precise nutritional guardrails required for the target audience, coming together easily in under 30 minutes.

dimensions.feedback: The flavor profile is classically balanced. The savory chicken and earthy white beans pair beautifully with the bright lemon juice, garlic, and aromatic Italian herbs.
All listed ingredients are used in the instructions, and no unlisted ingredients appear in the steps.
The instructions are thorough. Time ranges are provided, doneness cues (e.g., 'no longer pink', 'completely wilted') are present, and the check instruction at the minimum simmer time is included.
The recipe aligns perfectly with a Mediterranean flavor profile, utilizing olive oil, garlic, lemon, spinach, and white beans.
A one-pot stovetop method (sautéing the aromatics and protein, then simmering) is the ideal technique for this style of quick soup.
The nutritional values align well with the ingredients. The 37g of protein and nearly 10g of fiber are plausible for the amounts of ground chicken and white beans used.

The title accurately describes the dish, and the intro provides warm, supportive framing that highlights the functional benefits (steady energy, staying full) without making inappropriate health claims.
This is an appetizing, extremely practical, and comforting soup that a home cook would realistically enjoy making on a weeknight.
Fully delivers on the dual-purpose brief: high in fiber, rich in lean protein, well-controlled in saturated fat (relying on olive oil and lean chicken), with plenty of vegetable volume.
Zero added sugar, and the white beans provide an excellent, high-quality complex carbohydrate source that lands perfectly in the 25-45g target window.
Fits the 'light_main' soup criteria perfectly. The slight 7 kcal overage (447 vs 440) flagged by the automated check is trivial and does not hurt the recipe's function in this chapter.
A very fast recipe that genuinely takes under 30 minutes from start to finish. Using a frozen mirepoix blend is an excellent, practical shortcut for the intended audience.
